title: Disable Provider
description: Add persisted disabled flag to providers, toggleable via CLI, TUI, and Web UI. Routing engine skips disabled providers during fallback.

sections.title: Database
sections.content: Add `disabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` column to providers table via goose migration 024_add_disabled_to_providers.sql. SQLite boolean convention: 0=enabled, 1=disabled. Default 0 preserves existing behavior.

sections.title: Model + Repository
sections.content: Add `Disabled bool` to Provider struct, `Disabled *bool` to UpdateProviderRequest. Update all repo SELECT queries (GetByID, GetByName, List, ListByMetadata) to include disabled column. Update UPDATE query to set disabled. Create doesn't need it (DEFAULT 0).

sections.title: Service + Engine
sections.content: Provider service Update() handles Disabled pointer field. Engine adds `if rm.Provider.Disabled { continue }` check in all 4 handler loops (HandleChatCompletion, HandleChatCompletionStream, HandleAnthropicMessages, HandleAnthropicMessagesStream) after rate-limit check. Logs 'provider disabled' failure.

sections.title: Status API
sections.content: Add `Disabled bool` to ProviderStatus struct. GetStatus copies p.Disabled into response. No new endpoints needed — existing PUT /providers/{id} handles toggling.

sections.title: TUI
sections.content: Add Disabled field to ProviderStatusResponse. FetchStatusLocal passes through p.Disabled. View renders 'DISABLED' badge (MutedStyle) when p.Disabled, skipping rate-limit/auth display. Add 'd' key binding to toggle disable via APIClient PUT. Add ToggleProviderCmd function. Update footer help text.

sections.title: Web UI
sections.content: StatusView.svelte: render amber 'Disabled' badge when p.disabled. Dim card with opacity-50. Add 'Enable'/'Disable' toggle button calling PUT /api/v1/providers/{id}. toggleDisabled function updates local state and shows toast.

sections.title: CLI
sections.content: New CLI command: llm-router toggle-provider --name <name> [--enable|--disable]. Toggles by default, --enable/--disable for explicit state. Register in main.go switch. Update help text.
